caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged vertically in the center of the composition, set against a plain beige background. At the bottom is a wide, shallow plate colored in shades of gray, with slight shadowing on the left side suggesting light coming from the right. Resting on the plate is a ribbed, cylindrical jug or mug, also rendered in tones of gray, with a large, curved handle on the right side. The jug's surface has horizontal ridges and a shiny appearance, indicated by subtle highlights. On top of the jug sits a tall, narrow vessel with straight sides and small decorative handles on each side near the top, similarly shaded in gray with slight yellow accents on what appears to be its rim and contents. The alignment is vertical, and the overall arrangement is balanced and centered, with the objects presented in a realistic style with attention to shading and texture.
title: Tin Lard Lamp
